form.title: Fariin u reeb kooxdayada
form.name: Magaca (ikhtiyaari)
form.consent: Waxaan oggolahay in kooxdayadu xogtan u isticmaasho inay fariintayda kaga jawaabto.
form.success: Mahadsanid. Kooxdayadu waxay kuugu soo jawaabi doontaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
form.failure: Fariintaada lama diri karin. Noogu soo qor marwalugazo@gmail.com.
form.invalidContact: Geli iimayl ama lambar telefoon oo sax ah.
form.consentRequired: Fadlan oggolow ka hor intaadan dirin.
form.waitBeforeSend: Fadlan wax yar sug ka hor dirista.
form.lengthError: Hal ama dhowr meelood ayaa ka dheeraaday xadka la oggol yahay.
form.rateLimit: Sug 30 ilbiriqsi ka hor intaadan fariin kale dirin.

answers.welcome: Ku soo dhawoow Women Without Borders Hub. Waxaan ahay kaaliye otomaatig ah. I weydii barnaamijyadeenna, ku biirista, tabarucaadka, mutadawacnimada ama iskaashiga.
answers.about: Women Without Borders Hub waa urur bulsho oo ku yaal Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma, Kenya. Waxaa aasaastay MaLua Lugazo sannadkii 2024 si ay fursado ugu abuurto gabdhaha nugul, hooyooyinka da'da yar iyo haweenka da'da yar.
answers.founder: Women Without Borders Hub waxaa aasaastay MaLua Lugazo sannadkii 2024.
answers.location: Women Without Borders Hub waxay ku taallaa Xerada Qaxootiga Kakuma, Kenya.
answers.activities: Hawlaha waxay dhacaan Isniinta ilaa Jimcaha, 4ta galabnimo ilaa 6da galabnimo, Women Without Borders Center, Kakuma 3.
answers.join: Si aad ugu biirto mid ka mid ah barnaamijyadeenna, fadlan la xiriir kooxdayada si ay kuugu hagaan tallaabooyinka xiga. Iimayl u dir marwalugazo@gmail.com ama isticmaal bogga Xiriirka.
answers.joinDetails: Fadlan la xiriir kooxdayada, wayna ku hagi doonaan.
answers.donate: Waxaad ku tabaruci kartaa M-Pesa. Hadda ma lihin akoon bangi. Si aad u hesho faahfaahinta M-Pesa, iimayl u dir marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.volunteer: Si aad mutadawac u noqoto ama xirfadahaaga ula wadaagto, buuxi foomka codsiga mutadawacnimada. Kooxdayadu waxay kula soo xiriiri doontaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
answers.partner: Waxaan soo dhoweyneynaa iskaashiga deeq-bixiyeyaasha, NGO-yada, aasaasyada, dugsiyada, xarumaha tababarka, hay'adaha caafimaadka iyo ganacsiyada. Wada-hawlgalayaashu waxay taageeri karaan maalgelin, aqoon farsamo, tababar, hagid, agab ama barnaamijyo wadajir ah. Codsiga ku soo dir bogga Xiriirka ama iimaylka marwalugazo@gmail.com. Kooxdayadu waxay kuugu soo jawaabi doontaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
answers.skills: Haa, waxaad bixin kartaa hagid, tababar ama xirfado shaqo. La xiriir kooxdayada si aad uga wada hadashaan sida aad u caawin karto. Iimayl u dir marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.contact: Kooxdayada waxaad kala xiriiri kartaa marwalugazo@gmail.com. Caadi ahaan waxaan ku jawaabnaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
answers.responseTime: Kooxdayadu caadi ahaan waxay ku jawaabtaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood.
answers.emergency: Waan ka xumahay waxa kugu dhacay. Haddii adiga ama qof kale khatar ku jiro, hadda wac +254113947398.
answers.thanks: Adaa mudan. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan kaa caawin karo?
answers.goodbye: Waad ku mahadsan tahay booqashada Women Without Borders Hub. Is ilaali.
answers.privacyRefusal: Ma wadaagi karo xog shakhsiyeed oo ku saabsan ka qaybgalayaasha ama shaqaalaha. Haddii aad su'aal qabto, kala xiriir kooxdayada marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.adviceRefusal: Waxaan ahay kaaliye otomaatig ah mana bixin karo talo caafimaad, sharci ama la-talin nafsi. Fadlan la hadal xirfadle aqoon leh. Kooxdayada kala xiriir marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.fallback: Waad ku mahadsan tahay fariintaada. Weli ma hayo xogtaas. Kooxdayadu waxay kuugu soo jawaabi doontaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood. Fariin hoose ku reeb ama iimayl u dir marwalugazo@gmail.com.
answers.unsupportedLanguage: Waxaan ku jawaabi karaa Ingiriisi, Faransiis, Carabi, Sawaaxili, Soomaali, Isbaanish, Jarmal, Boortaqiis, Ruush, Talyaani iyo Boolish. Hadda waxaan kuugu jawaabi doonaa Ingiriisi. Kooxdayadu way kula soo xiriiri kartaa haddii aad fariin reebto.

education.title: Waxbarasho Fursad Labaad
education.answer: Deeqo waxbarasho, kooxaha akhris-qoraalka, taageero waxbarasho iyo waxbarashada fursadda labaad oo gabdhaha ka caawiya inay dugsiga sii joogaan, isla markaana fursado waxbarasho u fura gabdhaha nugul ee Kakuma.

digital.title: Xirfadaha Dijitaalka iyo Farsamada
digital.answer: Aqoonta kombiyuutarka iyo tababaro xooggan oo xirfadaha dijitaalka ah, iyo tababar xirfadeed oo ku saabsan tolidda, moodada, quruxda iyo timo-habaynta haweenka da'da yar.

mentorship.title: Hagid iyo Xirfadaha Nolosha
mentorship.answer: Hagid, xirfadaha nolosha, hoggaamin, talo shaqo, dejinta yoolal iyo aqoon dhaqaale oo dhisa kalsooni iyo isku-filnaansho.

health.title: Caafimaadka iyo Sharafta Caadada
health.answer: Waxbarashada caafimaadka caadada, agabka caadada, wacyigelinta caafimaadka iyo gudbinta adeegyada caafimaadka si aan qofna uga maqnaan dugsi ama shaqo.

srhr.title: Caafimaadka iyo Xuquuqda Galmada iyo Taranka (SRHR)
srhr.answer: Waxbarashada SRHR ee ku habboon da'da oo tixgelisa dhaqamada, waxbarashada asaagga iyo wacyigelinta bulshada oo ku dhisan ixtiraam iyo doorasho.

livelihood.title: Nolol-maalmeedka iyo Awood-siinta Dhaqaale
livelihood.answer: Ganacsi-abuur, hagid ganacsi, tababar shaqo, isku xirka suuqyada iyo gudbinta fursadaha shaqo si loo xoojiyo dhaqaalaha haweenka.
